patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows signing in with Google by using MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes the ads shown between deals and on the deal pages.

patches.name: Sanitize deal links
patches.description: Opens the store page of a deal directly, instead of through redirects that track the click and add affiliate links.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Shares the direct link to deals and discussions, instead of a link that redirects through a tracking service.

patches.name: Fix sidebar layout
patches.description: Keeps the sidebar of the website shown by the app clear of the status bar and the navigation bar.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows signing in with Google by using MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services.

patches.name: Hide newsletter prompt
patches.description: Hides the prompt to sign up for the newsletter on the website shown by the app.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides ads and blocks ad networks on the website shown by the app.
